title: CTD Studio Sidecar v1
description: Layout-only sidecar (<basename>.ctd.json) paired with a canonical diagram source file (e.g. <basename>.mmd). Must never embed BYOK API keys or secrets.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor tooling.

layout.description: Map of stable node IDs and edge anchor keys (`${edgeId}::start`, `${edgeId}::end`) to finite { x, y } coordinates.

meta.description: Optional provenance metadata for drift detection and CI.

generatedFrom.description: Relative path or filename of the paired diagram source file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the paired diagram source at last layout save.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sidecar was last written.
